title: E-Hospitality – Hospital Management System
description: End-to-end hospital management platform supporting patient registration, appointments, billing, and medical record tracking. Includes automated invoice generation and integrated Stripe payments.

title: Career Tracker – Job Application Manager
description: Job application tracking platform with resume versioning, dashboard analytics, and real-time status updates. Built for seamless cross-device performance.

title: Ciphernet – Social Platform
description: Full-featured social networking platform with secure authentication, email verification, messaging, and interactive user features.

title: Tourist Destinations
description: A Django web application for managing tourist destinations, allowing users to create, read, update, and delete destination information along with associated images. It includes a REST API for programmatic access and uses PostgreSQL as the database backend.

title: Blog Project
description: A comprehensive Django-based blogging platform featuring user authentication, profile management, blog posts with image uploads, commenting system, search functionality, and a custom admin panel for staff users.

title: Quizzler
description: Interactive quiz application demonstrating modern JavaScript practices, responsive UI, and clean component-driven architecture.

title: Turtle Crossing Game
description: Python-based arcade-style game demonstrating object-oriented programming, event handling, and clean game loop architecture.

title: Flashcard App
description: Interactive flashcard application for learning and review, featuring dynamic UI updates and user-friendly navigation.
